name: 16:8 Intermittent Fast
description: Fast for 16 hours, eat within an 8-hour window. A popular daily fasting pattern.

name: 18:6 Intermittent Fast
description: Fast for 18 hours, eat within a 6-hour window. An extended intermittent fast.

name: 24-Hour Fast
description: Complete 24-hour fasting period from dinner to dinner or lunch to lunch.

milestoneMessages.18: Three quarters done - you're doing great!

name: Lenten Fast
description: Traditional Catholic Lenten fasting - one full meal and two smaller meals that together do not equal a full meal.

name: Ash Wednesday Fast
description: Obligatory fast and abstinence from meat on Ash Wednesday.

name: Good Friday Fast
description: Obligatory fast and abstinence in remembrance of Christ's passion and death.
